beats.summary: Jan informs Michael that Dwight believes he can run the branch better, undermining Michael's authority.

evidence.snippet: Dwight just told me that he thinks he can run the branch better than you.
You can't have people undermining you. Get control of your branch immediately.

beats.summary: Michael reflects on his complicated relationship with Jan and Dwight's attempt to turn Jan against him.

evidence.snippet: That he could turn Jan against me? She's my ex-lover! …ish.

beats.summary: Michael demotes himself to Dwight's position and appoints Dwight as acting manager of the Scranton branch.

evidence.snippet: She demoted me to your job!

beats.summary: Michael announces to the office that Dwight will replace him as leader, citing Dwight's honesty as the reason.

evidence.snippet: I… am being replaced, as your leader, by Dwight.

beats.summary: Dwight and Andy argue during a video game about strategy and accuse each other of sabotage.

evidence.snippet: We just need a strategy, ok? We're going to set up a trap in the gun room.
Saboteur! I'm going to kill you for real.

beats.summary: Pam tries on a new red shirt but feels it is too much and considers returning it.

evidence.snippet: Pam walks out of the bathroom wearing her new red shirt
